game_title: Safe Get Scout – Summit Spire Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Summit Spire, the highest spire: the mountaineer must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Safe Get Scout: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors.
theme: Frost Peaks – Summit Spire: the highest spire
core_gameplay_loop: In Summit Spire, repeat each round: Use .get() with a default to avoid missing key errors. Each round, storm winds strike the supply cache, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the safe_lookups value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from storm winds in Summit Spire: keep the safe_lookups meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: safe_lookups drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): Safe Get Scout
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safe_lookups changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Summit Spire.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while safe_lookups > 0.
